references.text: This verse in Proverbs reflects the idea that whoever has will be given more, while whoever does not have will lose even what little they have.
In Luke we find a similar statement emphasizing the principle that those who have will be given more, and those who do not have will lose even what they have.
This verse in Matthew reflects the same theme as in Matthew 25:29, that those who have will be given more, and those who do not have will lose what they have.
